_comment: THE PILOT LINEUP — the STANDING ~16-figure approval set (dev/model-qa/REFERENCE-DIRECTION.md 'The approval flow', Adam 2026-07-03: style passes go pilot -> Adam approves -> sweep). One 4x4 sheet, fast to read. HAND-AUTHORED and deliberately stable: changing a pick is a deliberate act, not a regeneration — every entry notes its family and why it was chosen. Slugs validated against data/bestiary.js; ranks reference dev/model-qa/top100.json's encounter-weight order. Rendered by dev/model-lineup.html?set=pilot (grid cells A1..D4, row-major); `loadout` entries render through the REAL loadout-mirror path (pcRecipeFrom) as full gold PC figures.

cells.name: Wolf
cells.family: beast — the pack predator, THE quadruped read (top100 #19)

cells.name: Giant Spider
cells.family: beast/arachnid — the canonical SRD spider (cr1; no spider made top100, so the family's most recognizable face was chosen over the lower-CR giant-wolf-spider)

cells.name: Gray Ooze
cells.family: ooze — lowest-CR true ooze (cr 1/2); the blob-mass base's representative

cells.name: Specter
cells.family: ghost/spectre — the canonical translucent undead (cr1); exercises the `translucent` recipe flag

cells.name: Pseudodragon
cells.family: dragon-kin — the ONLY dragon-type in the top100 (#63); wings + tail + snout on a small frame

cells.name: Giant Bat
cells.family: flyer — the purest wing-slab silhouette in the encounterable band (top100 #62)

cells.name: Blind Deep-Stalker
cells.family: horror — highest-ranked true aberration (top100 #23); the amorphous-horror/eyeless read

cells.name: Skeleton
cells.family: core humanoid/undead — top100 #1; bone-white channel + skull head

cells.name: Zombie
cells.family: core humanoid/undead — top100 #2; slouch stance + rot channel

cells.name: Goblin Warrior
cells.family: core humanoid/goblinoid — top100 #9; carries a HAND OVERRIDE (model-recipe-overrides), so the pilot always shows override-path output too

cells.name: Bandit
cells.family: core humanoid — top100 #50; the plain-human baseline every other humanoid must read as different from

cells.name: Ogre
cells.family: giant — the classic giant-type brute (top100 #95); torso-biped-huge base

cells.name: Fighter (greatsword)
cells.family: PC loadout-mirror — martial silhouette, two-hander grip, chain mail (L15 PC-priority)
